description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class (NonGmailSentFolderHandlerTest) that tests various functionalities of the NonGmailSentFolderHandler class, including error handling, folder storage logic, and server connection methods within the context of SuiteCRM's email handling features.

classes.name: NonGmailSentFolderHandlerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify the behaviors of the NonGmailSentFolderHandler, including error handling, folder storage, and server connection functionalities.

methods.name: testClearLastError
methods.description: Tests that the handler's 'clearLastError' method resets the last error to null.

methods.name: testSetLastErrorNoInt
methods.description: Verifies that setting a non-integer value as last error throws an InvalidArgumentException with the specific code.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderNoIEIsNull
methods.description: Checks that storing in sent folder with a null inbound email argument results in an error and sets the last error appropriately.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderNoIE
methods.description: Tests storing in sent folder with a valid bean object but no inbound email triggers an error.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderIsPop3
methods.description: Verifies that when the protocol is 'pop3', storing in sent folder fails with the correct error.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderIsGmail
methods.description: Ensures that if the email is identified as Gmail, storing in sent folder returns false and sets an error.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderOk
methods.description: Tests a successful scenario where the protocol is not Gmail or Pop3, and the method completes without errors.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderNoIEID
methods.description: Checks that when the inbound email ID is not set, the method returns the appropriate error message.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderNoIEIDValue
methods.description: Checks that when the inbound email ID is empty, the error message indicates the ID is set but has no value.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderIsPop3
methods.description: Verifies that protocol 'pop3' results in an error message indicating a pop3 protocol.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderIsGmail
methods.description: Verifies that if the email protocol is 'pop3' but mail_smtptype is 'gmail', the method indicates it is a Gmail.

methods.name: testConnectToNonGmailServer
methods.description: Tests the connection method, including error handling for invalid input, and has placeholders for real connection tests commented out.
